title: Watch Codex companion: native frosted sessions

native.compatibility: iOS 27 is a visual reference only. Native SwiftUI materials; no glassEffect or SDK upgrade.
native.documentationScope: Source-extracted native values. No invented CSS aliases, fixed font sizes, HTML/CSS material approximations, or rendered previews.

liveSurfaces.units: SwiftUI points; semantic Dynamic Type text styles, not CSS pixels or fixed font metrics

colors.watchAccent: watchAccent (shared explicit sRGB constant; see demoSurfaces.colors.watchAccent)
colors.running: Color.accentColor on iPhone; watchAccent on Watch

backdrops.behavior: Omit gradient with accessibilityReduceTransparency; ignoresSafeArea; accessibilityHidden(true)

liveSurfaces.layout: Content-sized ScrollView and NavigationStack. iPhone setup steps use HStackLayout(spacing: 12), switching to leading VStackLayout(spacing: 12) at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes. Connected iPhone shows sessions above collapsed connection settings; recovery panel can precede sessions. Watch preserves snapshot thread order. No fixed breakpoints.
liveSurfaces.controls: Native bordered / borderedProminent buttons; iPhone controlSize(.large), selected action label minHeight 24 (not a total hit-target claim); Watch action labels minHeight 44. Native SecureField with roundedBorder for pairing. Native multiline iPhone TextField lineLimit 3...8; Watch system TextField. Native confirmation alerts; destructive role for stop and final execution.
liveSurfaces.state: Account completion from controller.signedIn, controller completion from controller.enrolled, host completion from snapshot.connected. Show receipt/status and busy cancellation from actual model state. No staged progress or demo data. Real-operation uncertainty remains visible; mutation availability remains controlled by model gates.
liveSurfaces.depth: Native materials and half-point outlines only; no custom shadows or backdrop blur ellipses.
liveSurfaces.motion: No custom visual animation; existing 350 ms post-confirmation sign-in dispatch delay is behavior, not a design motion token.
liveSurfaces.accessibility: Semantic typography, labeled state symbols, combined session-row children, hidden decorative artwork, Reduce Transparency solid fills, increased-contrast outlines. Implementation accommodations only, not verified accessibility compliance.
liveSurfaces.refresh: Phone controller.refresh() controls say 刷新会话; disabled busy || !snapshot.connected; empty-state refresh shown only when connected. loadHosts() says 刷新主机列表 and remains distinct. Watch refresh adds !snapshot.connected to busy/reachability guards. Intentional enablement strengthening, not a claim that every prior rule is frozen.
liveSurfaces.disclosures: All three phone DisclosureGroup labels use minHeight: 44 and contentShape(Rectangle()).

demoSurfaces.implementation: SwiftUI; semantic Dynamic Type styles, SF Symbols and native navigation. Values below are observed implementation literals; watchAccent is an explicit shared Watch constant.
demoSurfaces.units: points; typography uses semantic styles rather than fixed sizes

accent.usage: Adaptive asset retained on iPhone; Watch uses explicit watchAccent instead.

colors.watchCanvas: LinearGradient: black, watchAccent.opacity(0.16), black; topLeading to bottomTrailing; ignoresSafeArea
colors.error: Color.red; destructive controls use the native destructive role

watchAccent.application: Direct running-status references and WatchApp .tint(watchAccent).accentColor(watchAccent), with forced dark colorScheme; also used at 16% opacity in the backdrop gradient.

colors.phoneSecondaryCopy: Color.primary.opacity(0.65); tertiary chevrons and existing semantic detail-state/count styles unchanged

typography.family: system; no custom fonts or fixed line heights

demoSurfaces.depth: Native translucent materials, blurred color backdrops and half-point white edge highlights; no custom shadows.
demoSurfaces.motion: Native system behavior; no custom animation tokens.
demoSurfaces.layout: Content-sized vertical scroll views; no fixed breakpoint system. Watch uses snapshot order; iPhone groups running sessions first. PhoneActiveSession uses AnyLayout with leading VStackLayout(spacing: 8) at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes, HStackLayout and Spacer(minLength: 8) otherwise.
demoSurfaces.documentationScope: Current local glass-proposal SwiftUI sources only; unpublished, not simulator-verified. No HTML/CSS approximations or fixed font metrics.
demoSurfaces.verification: Local proposal only; no simulator verification or final visual, accessibility or contrast QA pass claimed. Fresh builds, protocol tests and rendered-device inspection remain required.
demoSurfaces.compatibility: Native materials supported by Xcode 16.4 and project targets; materials available on iOS 15+ and watchOS 10+. No glassEffect: it requires SDK 26. The iOS 27 reference is visual direction only.

native.verification: Source-only documentation review. Xcode and Swift unavailable here; no fresh build, simulator capture, visual/contrast/interaction verification, push, or cloud build performed. Existing demo descriptions retained separately; not new render evidence.

components.name: Live iPhone connection overview
components.description: Regular-material surface groups host/setup heading, truth-derived account/controller/host steps, read status, busy cancellation and experimental disclosure.

components.name: Live iPhone session row
components.description: Plain NavigationLink; state symbol and semibold status, headline title, up to three summary lines and two project lines; shared live phone surface.

components.name: Live Watch session row
components.description: Plain NavigationLink; caption2 state, up to three headline title lines and one project line; shared live Watch surface.

components.name: Live native actions
components.description: Native bordered / borderedProminent buttons; iPhone controlSize(.large), selected action label minHeight 24 (not a total hit-target claim); Watch action labels minHeight 44. Native SecureField with roundedBorder for pairing. Native multiline iPhone TextField lineLimit 3...8; Watch system TextField. Native confirmation alerts; destructive role for stop and final execution.

components.name: Live pairing and composer
components.description: Secure pairing field; native text composers with 2000-character count, blank/oversized and model-based mutation gates, confirmation alert and retained unsent draft.

components.name: Live native navigation
components.description: Codex Remote phone root, Remote Watch root; real-session detail screens. Connected phone connection settings and identifiers use DisclosureGroup.

components.name: Live recovery status
components.description: Orange symbol plus text describes uncertain real-operation outcome. Read and review actions remain explicit; neither decoration nor connectivity implies success.

components.name: Unchanged demo: Watch session row
components.description: Plain NavigationLink. Cyan running status and headline title; quieter medium subheadline title for other sessions. All rows use ultraThinMaterial, 12-point inset, 18-point continuous corners and a 0.5-point white edge at 14% opacity. Two-line title; one-line project. Combined accessibility children with state value.

components.name: Unchanged demo: iPhone active session
components.description: Plain NavigationLink. Title2 bold title, accent status/action, primary-at-65%-opacity project and up-to-three-line summary. UltraThinMaterial; 22-point inset; 24-point continuous corner; 0.5-point white edge at 30% opacity. Header stacks vertically with 8-point spacing at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes. Combined accessibility children.

components.name: Unchanged demo: iPhone recent session
components.description: Plain NavigationLink, native status symbol, headline title, project and state in primary at 65% opacity, tertiary chevron. No card fill. 15-point vertical padding; inset dividers between rows.

components.name: Unchanged demo: Native navigation
components.description: NavigationStack and NavigationLink; watch inline Codex title, iPhone native large root title and inline detail titles. Receipts and diagnostics remain below sessions or on connection screens.

components.name: Unchanged demo: Native actions
components.description: Watch bordered refresh/source controls with minimum height 44 and explicit accessibility labels; iPhone toolbar refresh and pull-to-refresh. Refresh disables while busy. Stop uses native destructive role and confirmationDialog.

components.name: Unchanged demo: Demo instruction field
components.description: Native TextField in List sections; watch system keyboard/dictation, iPhone multiline range 3...8. 2000-character limit with red error/count; preserve draft. Send disabled for unavailable mutation, running thread, blank or oversized input.

components.name: Unchanged demo: iPhone Watch connection card
components.description: Plain NavigationLink with native Watch symbol, reachability label and tertiary chevron. ThinMaterial; 16-point inset and continuous corner; 0.5-point white edge at 22% opacity. Device reachability is not Remote authorization.

narrative.overview: Native frosted-glass redesign of live iPhone and Watch surfaces. Session-first once connected, guided setup when disconnected, compact Watch hierarchy. Unchanged demo surfaces remain separate and explicitly simulated.
keyCharacteristics: Native adaptive materials and semantic type
dos: Use native values from the correct surface scope.
Keep uncertainty, connection truth and experimental disclosures visible.
Verify small Watch and accessibility sizes before visual sign-off.
donts: Do not claim iOS 27 APIs, glassEffect, rendered QA or a successful build.
Do not label live sessions as simulated or mix demo data into live views.
Do not infer operational readiness from styling.
